text:
Situation: Meropenem is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 337 vials (22.3 days), Corvale General holds 425 vials (27.9 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 29 vials (11.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include meropenem as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers system needs for 11 to 28 days depending on site. Lakeside's 11.2-day supply warrants proactive purchasing to prevent a site-level shortage. No FDA shortage declaration exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Gland Pharma Limited (plant GLAND PHARMA LIMITED, last inspection VAI 2023-06-27); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer places purchase order with WG Critical Care, LLC (plant HQ SPCLT PHARMA); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer places purchase order with ARMAS PHARMACEUTICALS INC (plant BROOKS STERISCIENCE LIMITED, last inspection VAI 2024-11-12); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer evaluates Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC and B. Braun Medical Inc. for secondary supply; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: Delaying purchases until a site reaches critical stock levels.
